label: Lead Qualification Engine

label: Bond Lifecycle Manager
info:
Relationship + bond lifecycle automation.

2) GAS runTheCloser for abandoned intakes
3) Slack stuck-stage + missing court-date alerts

label: Risk Mitigation Loop

3) Leads POST /api/automation/risk-mitigation
4) Slack #alerts on high risk / FTA / forfeiture
